controls.reason: Ten configured limits do not prove every agent, tool, child process and retry path is bounded or that the bounds are safe.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The primary executor can enforce all fields while a spawned helper or external tool runs beyond the token or command limit.

controls.reason: Outbound restriction and safe download validation require complete network-path coverage and security judgment over arbitrary content and tools.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Allowlisted destinations can pass while a trusted host serves a malicious installer or a tool opens an unmonitored channel.

controls.reason: Immediate has no response-time threshold, and capability presence does not prove pause, cancellation, revocation and kill switch work in all execution states.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Buttons and APIs can exist while a blocked tool call ignores cancellation or credential caches remain active.

controls.reason: Six adversarial test categories do not provide exhaustive prompts, tools, privilege paths, loop states or correct safety oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Named fixtures can pass while an indirect instruction in a downloaded file causes a privileged action.

controls.reason: An AI-component inventory cannot prove inclusion of every model, prompt, policy, index, data set, evaluator and dynamically selected external tool.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All eleven sections can be populated while provider routing silently introduces an unrecorded model or tool.

controls.reason: A deployed AI configuration can be content-addressed and bound to an immutable release record covering model, prompt, retrieval, routing, tools and policy.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Any deployed configuration change without a new release digest breaks the exact provenance binding.

controls.reason: Model and adapter artifacts can be verified against approved digests or signatures and retrieved only through authenticated policy-allowed channels.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A hash mismatch, missing signature or unapproved unauthenticated source fails the bounded artifact and channel checks.

controls.reason: Review records for six hazards do not prove repositories and models are safe or that hidden executable behavior and permissions were fully found.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All checklist fields can pass while a custom deserializer executes code through an unrecognized format.

controls.reason: The negative claim spans every repository, notebook, script, custom-code path and credential inheritance mechanism.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Approved runners can isolate known inputs while an extension executes untrusted setup code with cached production credentials.

controls.reason: Credential and data separation must hold across every store, role, log, cache, tool and execution path; role labels alone are insufficient.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Three environments can have separate accounts while a shared retrieval index or inherited token exposes production data to evaluation.

controls.reason: Access control over six AI configuration surfaces requires complete mutation-path and identity inventory, including provider and emergency paths.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Declared ACLs can pass while an indirect deployment variable or provider console changes routing without the authorized role.

controls.reason: Complete provider-change detection and adequate review and testing cannot be proven from change records or provider labels.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known minor changes can be reviewed while a silent model update alters behavior without any event to trigger testing.

controls.reason: A rollback record and successful drill do not prove a known evaluated model remains available or works for every production state and dependency.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The pinned version can roll back in staging while the provider withdraws it or a new data schema makes it unusable.

controls.reason: Monitoring five provider risks depends on incomplete external status, policy, distribution and model-update channels.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Configured feeds can be current while a silent weight update or compromised mirror is never reported.

controls.reason: A retirement policy can define procedures for the six exact models, embeddings, prompts, credentials, retained-data and derivative categories.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Omitting downstream derivatives or credential retirement fails the finite policy schema.

controls.reason: Actual tasks, repositories, languages, domains, users, tools and risk conditions require complete scope discovery and representative evaluation judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A custom benchmark can include one example per category while omitting the hardest production repository and user risk.

controls.reason: Seven scenario labels do not establish realistic coverage, interaction combinations or authoritative expected outcomes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each scenario can have a fixture while conflicting requirements combined with hidden instructions still cause unsafe behavior.

controls.reason: Four refusal and escalation conditions do not define complete requests, permissions, capabilities, confidence states or correct escalation outcomes.

controls.reason: Seven fabrication categories and finite prompts cannot prove the tool avoids fabricated outputs over arbitrary engineering contexts.

controls.reason: Seven security attack labels do not define exhaustive prompt, content, tool, identity and sandbox paths or a complete adversarial oracle.

controls.reason: Six change and degradation categories do not provide complete versions, combinations, tasks, dependencies or correctness and safety oracles.

controls.reason: True curation independence and absence of evaluation-set contamination require provenance and open-world training-data knowledge unavailable from records alone.

controls.reason: Calibration validity requires representative outcome labels, statistical assumptions and task-specific thresholds, not just a confidence metric.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A reliability curve can look calibrated on biased data while autonomous high-risk actions remain badly miscalibrated.

controls.reason: An evaluation policy can define separate numeric acceptance thresholds for every registered task-and-harm pair and prohibit aggregate-only approval.

controls.reason: Relevant subgroups, languages, accessibility needs, repositories and domains plus meaningful difference interpretation require contextual judgment.

controls.reason: A capability state machine can block expansion of permissions, autonomy, data, users or production scope unless new evaluation evidence predates the transition.

controls.reason: Executing seven documentation procedures does not prove instructions are correct, accessible, safe and complete across actual environments.

controls.reason: Guaranteeing authoritative current search results over all queries and generated duplicates requires complete content inventory, ranking semantics and changing authority.

controls.reason: The reviewed final artifact can be content-addressed and retained as the authoritative output independently of transient conversation history.

controls.reason: The rule depends on what provenance claims communicate and whether their presentation implies truth, harmlessness, completeness, or lack of bias.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The provenance record and its typed status can be correct while surrounding prose overstates what provenance proves, so record equality passes a broken presentation.

controls.reason: Recognized, current, interoperable and required are contextual or external-standard judgments that change by format, ecosystem and use.

controls.reason: A provenance manifest signature and content digest can bind the exact asset or an explicitly typed, hashed derivative relationship.

controls.reason: Authorization policy is bounded, but key protection across copies, signers, backups and compromise paths is an open-world security claim.

controls.reason: The provenance state is objective, but deciding whether the full presentation claims the underlying content is necessarily false requires semantic UI review.

controls.reason: Canonicalization, proof-suite and interoperability validation spans complex protocols, implementations and adversarial inputs without an exhaustive oracle.
